snippet.title: SimplePlanes 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist it today on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840470/SimplePlanes_2

Here are the crafts we used in the video. They have been updated to make use of many of the new features in SP2 such as aircraft textures, new wings, procedural jet engines, ambient occlusion, etc.

Grumman F-14B "Tomcat" USAF ADCOM Interceptor by @TheAviator77
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/g54Lo9/Grumman-F-14B-Tomcat-USAF-ADCOM-Interceptor

KRI Klewang Corvette Class by @MufazzalCorporation
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/1z81ad/KRI-Klewang-Corvette-Class

MSC Vengeance (SBM-1) by @EternalDarkness
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/cZ5Fc2/MSC-Vengeance-SBM-1

AFT-09 HJ-9 anti-tank missile launch vehicle by @FengRedWhite
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/H0sV8r/AFT-09-HJ-9-anti-tank-missile-launch-vehicle

A-10 N/AW by @wfy312
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/f2Ca3f/A-10-N-AW

A-10A Thunderbolt II by @maxres
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/V3jd1p/A-10A-Thunderbolt-II

Mirage 2000 by @Dutzz
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/U81K44/Mirage-2000

B-25J Mitchell by @Aghsan22
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/hoGyGV/B-25J-Mitchell

Royal Revenge by @210100
https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/229u06/Royal-Revenge

Music by Fat Bard
https://www.fatbard.com/

Voice over by Tom Bennett
